en.F1 赛事中心 — 鸿蒙原生 F1 粉丝应用: F1 Race Center — a native HarmonyOS app for F1 fans
en.赛程、积分榜、赛果、车手与车队资料、桌面卡片与赛事提醒。一款完全免费、无广告的鸿: Schedules, standings, results, driver and team profiles, home screen cards and race reminders. A completely free, ad-free F1 fan app built for HarmonyOS.
en.下一节次、最新赛果与整个赛季，都在一处。鸿蒙原生，完全免费，无广告。: The next session, the latest results and the whole season, together. Native to HarmonyOS. Completely free. No ads.
en.鸿蒙原生 · 为车迷而做: NATIVE TO HARMONYOS · MADE FOR FANS
en.下一节次、最新赛果与整个赛季，都在一处。没有广告，没有账号，也没有干扰你看比赛的: The next session, the latest results and the whole season, together. No ads, no account, nothing getting between you and the racing.
en.当前版本 1.0.0 · 简体中文 / English · 非官方粉丝应用: Version 1.0.0 · Simplified Chinese / English · Unofficial fan app
en.打开就是下一个真正要开始的节次。练习赛、冲刺排位、排位赛和正赛，都按你的本地时间: Open the app to the next session that is actually about to begin. Practice, sprint qualifying, qualifying and the race, all in your local time, down to the minute.
en.切到「已结束」，最近一场的领奖台直接置顶，页面辉光也会变成夺冠车队的颜色。: Switch to completed races and the latest podium takes the top spot. The page glow changes to the winning team's color.
en.普通与冲刺周末各自显示正确节次，不让你自己判断。: Standard and sprint weekends show their own sessions. No figuring it out yourself.
en.公开坐标生成矢量路径，跟随主题色，放大依旧清晰。: Public coordinates become vector paths that follow your theme and stay sharp when enlarged.
en.已结束的分站与最新领奖台: Completed races and the latest podium
en.完整成绩、名次变化与积分: Full results, position changes and points
en.两位数名次、车手与车队、醒目的积分。去掉多余卡片边框，用细线与留白建立秩序，扫一: Two-digit positions, drivers and teams, points that stand out. Fine lines and space replace unnecessary card borders, so the championship picture reads at a glance.
en.颜色直接落在车队名上，不再额外增加无意义的装饰色条。: Color goes directly on team names, without extra decorative bars.
en.顶部辉光取领跑者的车队色，让页面上下文自然变化。: The glow at the top takes the leading team's color, giving each page its own context.
en.积分榜、赛果和领奖台上的车手与车队都可以直接打开。经历、本赛季表现、生涯战绩和相: Open drivers and teams directly from standings, results and podiums. Background, this season, career results and related news stay on one clear path.
en.生涯列表回溯至 2001 年，旧车队保留各自时代的代表色。: Career records go back to 2001. Past teams keep the colors of their era.
en.人物介绍标注出处并可返回原词条，资讯不伪装成原创。: Profiles cite their sources and link back to the original entry. Sourced information never poses as original reporting.
en.ArkTS / ArkUI 从零构建。服务卡片、实况窗与系统意图不是附加功能，而: Built from scratch with ArkTS / ArkUI. Service cards, Live View and system intents are part of the experience itself.
en.不打开，也不会错过。: Stay in the loop, without opening the app.
en.七款原生服务卡片把下一节次、积分榜、新闻与关注对象留在桌面，由服务器静默推送更新: Seven native service cards keep the next session, standings, news and favorites on your home screen, with silent updates from the server.
en.F1 赛事中心桌面卡片: F1 Race Center home screen cards
en.只在你需要时提醒。: A reminder when you want one.
en.默认关闭。可选赛前 15 / 30 / 60 分钟与赛程变更提醒；关闭后，相关服: Off by default. Choose reminders 15, 30 or 60 minutes before a session, plus schedule changes. Turning them off also deletes the related server records.
en.锁屏也能看比赛。: Follow the race from your lock screen.
en.正赛中的实时位次与圈数，抬手就能确认。: Check live positions and lap counts during the race with a glance.
en.说出你想看的。: Say what you want to see.
en.车手、车队与某站赛果均注册为系统意图。: Drivers, teams and race results are registered as system intents.
en.只调用 ArkUI、ArkData、NetworkKit、FormKit 与 P: Uses only ArkUI, ArkData, NetworkKit, FormKit and PushKit.
en.新闻只按发布时间倒序，不做个性化推荐。中文机翻仅作辅助，点击后回到原站阅读正文。: News is strictly newest first, without personalized recommendations. Chinese machine translations are a reading aid; open the original site for the full article.
en.浅色、深色或跟随系统，再从九种主题色中选择一种。车队品牌色不受主题影响。: Choose light, dark or system appearance, then one of nine theme colors. Team brand colors stay independent of your theme.
en.原标题、参考译文与来源: Original headlines, reference translations and sources
en.这些开放项目与公开站点，让一个人也能做出完整、可信的 F1 应用。: These open projects and public websites make it possible for one person to build a complete, trustworthy F1 app.
en.motorsport.com、Autosport、Formula1.com 公开: Public RSS feeds from motorsport.com, Autosport and Formula1.com. Only headlines, sources and times are shown; article bodies are neither stored nor republished.
en.百度百科相应词条；应用内标注来源并提供原词条链接。: Corresponding Baidu Baike entries, with attribution and links to the originals inside the app.
en.的赛道坐标，经投影与归一化后生成矢量路径: circuit coordinates, projected and normalized into vector paths
en.部分车队徽标与车手肖像来自维基共享资源；详细许可与署名见应用内第三方声明。: Some team logos and driver portraits come from Wikimedia Commons. See the in-app third-party notices for full licensing and attribution.
en.上游赛事数据以 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可发布，因此本应用始终完全免费: Upstream race data is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. This app therefore remains completely free, ad-free and non-commercial. Data obtained through it must not be used commercially.
en.与 Formula 1、国际汽车联合会（FIA）及各参赛车队均无隶属、赞助或认可: Not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Formula 1, the FIA or any competing team. Names and logos identify the respective teams only.
en.无账号、无广告、无第三方 SDK。仅在你主动开启赛事提醒时收集用于下发通知的推送: No account, no ads, no third-party SDKs. A push identifier is collected only when you enable race reminders and deleted when you disable them. All other settings and caches stay on your device.
en.本页截图取自开发中的构建，界面与数据可能与最终版本不同。: Screenshots are from a development build. The interface and data may differ from the final release.

ko.人物介绍标注出处并可返回原词条，资讯不伪装成原创。: 인물 소개는 출처를 표기하고 원문 항목으로 돌아갈 수 있어, 정보가 창작물인 척하지 않습니다.

ko.浅色、深色或跟随系统，再从九种主题色中选择一种。车队品牌色不受主题影响。: 라이트, 다크 또는 시스템 설정 따르기 중에서 고르고, 아홉 가지 테마 색 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다. 팀 브랜드 색은 테마의 영향을 받지 않습니다.
ko.这些开放项目与公开站点，让一个人也能做出完整、可信的 F1 应用。: 이 오픈 프로젝트들과 공개 사이트 덕분에 혼자서도 완전하고 믿을 수 있는 F1 앱을 만들 수 있었습니다.
ko.motorsport.com、Autosport、Formula1.com 公开: motorsport.com, Autosport, Formula1.com이 공개한 RSS. 제목, 출처, 시간만 표시하며 본문을 저장하거나 전재하지 않습니다.
ko.百度百科相应词条；应用内标注来源并提供原词条链接。: 바이두 백과의 해당 항목이며, 앱 안에서 출처를 표기하고 원문 항목 링크를 제공합니다.
